ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity (white/off-white) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity (white) contiguous regions occupy the lateral lobes. A central low-intensity (black) anchor originates at the insertion point, bisecting the lobes and extending along the interior trailing edge. Fine-grained low-intensity mottling and linear streaks are distributed across the high-intensity lateral fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a vertex angle of approximately 88-92 degrees; notch depth is approximately 12% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude (2-4 pixel) serration along the distal trailing edge. The left lobe exhibits more pronounced, irregular jagged peaks compared to the smoother trajectory of the right lobe's outer trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The leading edges display a symmetrical concave trajectory from the center to the distal tips, terminating in sharp upward-curving points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, high-texture clusters of high-intensity pixels (barnacle colonies) are localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes. Small isolated white circular marks are visible within the dark central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are detected. One prominent vertical-oblique mark is visible on the upper-left lobe; three distinct diagonal rake marks are visible on the mid-to-lower right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at both distal tips. Multiple linear rake marks/scars across the white surface of both lobes. A distinct small U-shaped indentation (likely tissue loss) is visible on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of low-intensity yellowish-brown pigment shifts (staining) on the high-intensity regions of the right lobe near the median notch.
